lines.en: Your school concert is tomorrow, right?
Yes, Grandma. I will sing a song on stage.
lines.ko: 네, 할머니. 무대에서 노래를 부를 거예요.

lines.en: Great! I will sit in the audience and watch.
Will you come with Grandpa too?
Of course. Grandpa loves music.
Last year I danced. This year I sing.
I remember. Your dance was great last year.
Are you going to take pictures?
Yes. And after the performance, let's eat cake.
lines.ko: 네. 그리고 공연 끝나면 케이크 먹어요.

lines.en: Great! I can't wait for tomorrow.
Hi! Did you enjoy the performance last night?
Yes. The music last night was so beautiful.
I loved the dance after the first song.
lines.ko: 저는 첫 노래 다음에 나온 춤이 정말 좋았어요.

lines.en: Yes! The actors were great. Do you sing?
I sing at home, but only for fun.
There is a concert at the theater next week.
Oh, who will play at the concert?
Some young people from our town.
Let's go together. Do you want to?
Sure! I will buy the tickets tomorrow.
